hints: "Watch for new images" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Merge" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"loop all over your images" uses NodeLoop: process each item/batch, return through NEXT, and continue only after all results are collected.

"remove background fixed size" sends its multipart-form-data body and reads the response as a file with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s); the file comes from "Download Image".
"remove background" sends its multipart-form-data body and reads the response as a file with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s); the file comes from "Download Image".
"Upload Picture to Google Drive" uploads the file from "remove background fixed size" to Google Drive (bytes or URL) with GOOGLESUPER_UPLOAD_FILE.
"Upload Picture to Google Drive1" uploads the file from "remove background" to Google Drive (bytes or URL) with GOOGLESUPER_UPLOAD_FILE.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## About this worfklow 

## How it works
This workflow does watch out for new images uploaded within Google Drive. 
Once there are new images it will download the image. And then run some logic, remove the background and add some padding to the output image. 
**By default Images are saved as .png**
Once done upload it to Google Drive again.
## Features* Select Google Drive Credentials within the Google Drive Nodes
### This workflow supports
* Remove Background
* Transparent Background
* Coloured Background (1 Color)
* Add Padding
* Choose Output Size

## Customize it!
* Feel free to customize the workflow to your needs
* Speed up the workflow: Using fixed output size
### Examples 
* Send Final Images to another service
* For Products: Let ChatGPT Analyze the Product Type
* Add Text with the "Edit Image" Node

For the API Key you can also setup an Header Authentication

-HEX or values like white, transparent...
